label: Protein · MSA server
description: Official protein example, with the public MSA server enabled because the YAML does not provide an MSA.

values.yaml_spec:
version: 1  # Optional, defaults to 1
sequences:
  - protein:
      id: A
      sequence: QLEDSEVEAVAKGLEEMYANGVTEDNFKNYVKNNFAQQEISSVEEELNVNISDSCVANKIKDEFFAMISISAIVKAAQKKAWKELAVTVLRFAKANGLKTNAIIVAGQLALWAVQCG

label: Protein · single sequence
description: Official protein example that explicitly disables MSA input; it runs without an MSA server.

values.yaml_spec:
version: 1  # Optional, defaults to 1
sequences:
  - protein:
      id: A
      sequence: QLEDSEVEAVAKGLEEMYANGVTEDNFKNYVKNNFAQQEISSVEEELNVNISDSCVANKIKDEFFAMISISAIVKAAQKKAWKELAVTVLRFAKANGLKTNAIIVAGQLALWAVQCG
      msa: empty

label: Cyclic protein
description: Official cyclic-protein example using Boltz's native cyclic flag.

values.yaml_spec:
version: 1  # Optional, defaults to 1
sequences:
  - protein:
      id: A
      sequence: QLEDSEVEAVAKG
      cyclic: true

label: Protein–ligand affinity
description: Official protein–ligand example requesting Boltz-2's affinity property for the ligand.

values.yaml_spec:
version: 1  # Optional, defaults to 1
sequences:
  - protein:
      id: A
      sequence: 
  - ligand:
      id: B
      smiles: 'N[C@@H](Cc1ccc(O)cc1)C(=O)O'
properties:
  - affinity:
      binder: B
